name.value: Powerhouse at Stave Falls Visitor Centre

description.value: The Powerhouse at Stave Falls is a preserved historic hydroelectric facility dating to 1911, operated by BC Hydro as a museum and visitor centre along Dewdney Trunk Road near Mission. The complex — centred on the original Stave Falls Dam and Powerhouse — tells the story of early electricity generation in British Columbia through intact turbines and heritage infrastructure. Cyclists touring the Fraser Valley will find it a distinctive heritage stop in a scenic river valley setting.
